description:
Create the new `jmap-jscalendar-types` crate scaffolding and move the 14 RFC 8984 typed sub-types into it from `crate-jmap-calendars-types/src/jscalendar.rs`.

## Mechanical steps

1. Create directory `crate-jmap-jscalendar-types/` with:
   - `Cargo.toml` (workspace inheritance for edition, version, license, MSRV; deps: serde, serde_json — both via `{ workspace = true }`).
   - `src/lib.rs` with `#![forbid(unsafe_code)]` and module declarations.
   - `AGENTS.md` mirroring the type-crate idiom (foundation-shaped — closer to jmap-types AGENTS.md than to jmap-mail-types).
   - `PLAN.md` containing the rationale moved from `crate-jmap-calendars-types/PLAN.md §1-§8` (with `.md` cross-reference back).
   - `README.md` summarising the crate's purpose: "RFC 8984 JSCalendar typed sub-types for the jmap-* crate family. Consumed by jmap-calendars-types and jmap-tasks-types."

2. Move the 14 typed sub-types from `crate-jmap-calendars-types/src/jscalendar.rs`:
   - `LocalDateTime` (line 31)
   - `Duration` (line 55)
   - `SignedDuration` (line 80)
   - `NDay` (line 106)
   - `RecurrenceRule` (line 126)
   - `Location` (line 202)
   - `VirtualLocation` (line 240)
   - `Link` (line 272)
   - `Relation` (line 329)
   - `Participant` (line 345)
   - `OffsetTrigger` (line 452)
   - `AbsoluteTrigger` (line 470)
   - `AlertTrigger` (line 492)
   - `Alert` (line 540)
   Preserve all derives, serde attributes, doc comments, and `#[non_exhaustive]` markers exactly. This is a pure move — zero behavioural change.

3. Move all associated tests with the types. If tests are in `#[cfg(test)] mod tests` blocks inside jscalendar.rs, they move with the types. If they're in a separate file, they move too.

4. Add the new crate as a workspace member in the top-level `Cargo.toml`.

## Module layout

Options for the new crate's `src/`:
- (a) Single `lib.rs` containing all 14 types (mirrors current jscalendar.rs structure).
- (b) Split by RFC 8984 section (e.g. `recurrence.rs` for RecurrenceRule + NDay, `location.rs` for Location + VirtualLocation, `participant.rs`, `alert.rs` for Alert + triggers, `time.rs` for LocalDateTime/Duration/SignedDuration, `link.rs`, `relation.rs`).

Recommendation: (a) for the initial extraction — keep this child a pure move with zero refactoring. If splitting is desired, do it in a follow-up bead after the move is verified. The point of this child is "no behavioural change", and module reshape adds review surface.

## Acceptance

- `cargo check -p jmap-jscalendar-types` clean.
- `cargo test -p jmap-jscalendar-types` clean (the moved tests pass in their new home).
- `cargo clippy -p jmap-jscalendar-types -- -D warnings` clean.
- `cargo doc -p jmap-jscalendar-types --no-deps` clean.
- `cargo metadata` lists the new crate as a workspace member.
- `crate-jmap-calendars-types/src/jscalendar.rs` is untouched at this point (its update is child .2).
- `cargo check --workspace` still passes because calendars-types continues to use its local jscalendar.rs until .2 lands.

## Cookie-cutter consistency

This crate is **foundation-shaped**, not extension-types-shaped. It sits at the level of `jmap-types` (no JMAP dep, pure spec types). Its AGENTS.md should reflect that — derive idiom and constraints from `crate-jmap-types/AGENTS.md`, not from the extension-types canonical template.

No public API additions/renames/removals to ANY existing crate — calendars-types still works because its local jscalendar.rs is unchanged in this child.
title: Create new jmap-jscalendar-types crate (scaffolding + move types from calendars-types)
